_what: W4b T5 (B1 §8.3, A7 Part B): a member that turns limited while queued in the move lane. Two real cc-lr move batches, started only by tests/rig/poller-standin (the tree's own lr-reset-poller.sh --move-kick). Batch 0 queues one extra idle row on next3 at go with --slots 1; its kitty calls are slowed (12 calls at 25-35 s) so it holds the one lane slot for minutes. Batch 1 queues the subject (idle at rest on next) at go + 30, so its worker sits in the SLOT WAIT; at go + 150 the subject takes a turn that hits the limit (stub idle_then_limit). Cure (W5 Part B): the worker's 30 s re-read lets it go NOTMOVED `became-limited … the reconciler recovers it` within T5's 120 s, and the reconciler drives it. Red (tree:<W5 parent>@31): the worker holds it through the slot wait, so the release is late (or a slot-wait expiry). Eight clean-limited members around it keep the reconciler's own lane busy on the shared slot store. All nine are expected ENGAGED.
